rationale: SCP identity, policy enforcement, proxy routing admission, ingress/egress authorization, trust validation and bypass prevention are deterministic fail-closed security operations. Decision Fabric must not grant network permission, expand destinations, select providers, bypass Layer/Scope Guard, choose hardware, expose services or promote runtime evidence. Advisory ranking is not required for communication authorization.

project_radar_review.scope: SCP Fabric against existing FA3 Security Governance, Trust PKI, Secret Broker, HRB, Reuse Discovery and Current Host boundaries
project_radar_review.note: SCP is an enforcement/projection layer and does not own candidate ranking or permission.
